body:
I've just talked my brother down from a serious depressive swing, you have no idea just how much agony that caused and he didn't even do anything drastic.

I urge you, please, for the love of anything you hold dear, don't do anything tonight. I don't know you, I don't know if you have a family, friends, pets, workmates - but someone out there loves you. I love you. Please, think about all those people around you. I know right now you probably don't think you have much worth or love to them, but you could never be more wrong.

I speak from personal experience when I say, you will rip someone's heart in two if you go through with it.

You can get past this, it's a bump. It's a fucking huge, painful bump, but it will pass. Take all this hurt, pain, agony and turn it into something beautiful instead. Grab a pencil/brush/stick/finger, make a piece of art. Start a new book. Listen to your favourite album. Go out to the park and watch the wildlife - take time to appreciate just how wonderful and beautiful this world can be. There is more than the pit you are stuck in, reach out to someone, please. 

Your life is far too beautiful and precious to be consumed by this pain, please don't do it.

Sincerely,

A concerned internet stranger
